faqs.question: Do you install and commission machines at our factory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our experienced technicians visit your factory to handle machine installation, calibration, and commissioning, ensuring the equipment is ready for production.

faqs.question: Are machines available from stock?
faqs.answer: Commonly used machine models are generally available in stock and can be dispatched promptly. For customized machines or special configurations, the typical delivery timeline is 4–8 weeks, depending on the specifications and production requirements. Our team will confirm the estimated delivery schedule during the quotation process.

faqs.question: Is operator training included?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We provide comprehensive operator training during installation, covering machine operation, maintenance procedures, safety guidelines, and best practices for maximum productivity.

faqs.question: Can you help with factory layout planning?
faqs.answer: Yes. We assist with factory layout and production flow planning to help optimize space utilization, improve workflow efficiency, and maximize machine performance.

faqs.question: Which industries do you serve?
faqs.answer: We serve a wide range of industries, including furniture manufacturing, modular furniture production, interior fit-outs, woodworking workshops, panel processing facilities, cabinetry, and custom wood product manufacturers.

faqs.question: Can we see a machine demonstration?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can arrange live demonstrations, either at our showroom, customer sites, or through video demonstrations, so you can evaluate the machine’s performance before making a decision.

faqs.question: What payment terms do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible payment terms based on the order value and machine type. Our sales team will discuss suitable payment options during the quotation process.

faqs.question: How do you recommend the right machine?
faqs.answer: Our technical experts assess your production requirements, factory space, output goals, and budget to recommend the most suitable machinery solution.

faqs.question: Can we get a custom quotation for a full line?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can provide customized quotations for individual machines or complete factory setups based on your production requirements.
